title: "Metal Gear Solid Touch" only works with Japanese language
author: ciciplusplus
body:
### App DB report link

https://appdb.touchhle.org/apps/122

### App name

MGSTouch

### App version

1.0.0

### touchHLE version

v0.2.2-653-g12419373

### Operating system

macOS

### GPU

Apple M1 GPU

### What is the problem with the app?

If English is used and more logs are enabled:

```
touchHLE::frameworks::foundation::ns_property_list_serialization: Reading plist from GuestPath("/var/mobile/Applications/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/METAL GEAR SOLID TOUCH.app/English.lproj/Localizable.strings").
touchHLE::frameworks::foundation::ns_property_list_serialization: Couldn't parse plist, returning nil: InvalidTrailerObjectOffsetSize (offset 77894)
```

Checking with plutil confirms that file is OK:

```
% plutil English.lproj/Localizable.strings
English.lproj/Localizable.strings: OK
```

The issue is probaly comes from `plist` crate. it's reproducable with both 1.3.1 and 1.7.0 versions
